critical_code_review_comments: ringtone-select.tsx: ref-based audio lifecycle is correct — playerRef is read/written outside React state so rapid taps don't fight stale closures; stopCurrent() pauses BEFORE remove() (both wrapped in try/catch) which guarantees the previous clip stops before the next one is created (fixes the overlap bug); useEffect(() => stopCurrent, [stopCurrent]) hard-stops on unmount preventing audio leak when leaving the screen. play() promise on L83-85 is .catch()'d so web autoplay-gating rejection doesn't surface as pageerror — verified: 0 errors after 4 rapid taps on web.

Reselecting the same row replays from the top — because stopCurrent() tears down the previous player BEFORE we createAudioPlayer(ring.source) again, so tapping 'pop' twice creates a fresh player instance the second time (no silent no-op). This matches objective B's 'same row twice should restart'.

KeyboardProviderShim platform resolution: the .web.tsx file exports KeyboardProviderShim (pass-through fragment), KeyboardAwareScrollViewShim (forwarded RN ScrollView with bottomOffset stripped from rest), and KeyboardAvoidingViewShim (RN View with behavior/keyboardVerticalOffset stripped) — strips the keyboard-controller-specific props so they don't leak to DOM. .native.tsx re-exports the real react-native-keyboard-controller components. _layout.tsx wraps the app in KeyboardProviderShim — on web this becomes <>{children}</> with zero runtime overhead. Metro/Expo's platform-extension resolver picks .web.tsx for web bundle and .native.tsx for iOS/Android — confirmed working (no 'KeyboardProvider is not defined' errors on web preview).

alarm-edit.tsx ActionSheet wrap: Modal -> KeyboardAvoidingView (shim) -> Pressable(backdrop) + Pressable(sheet) is correct ordering. On native the keyboard-controller's KeyboardAvoidingView will lift the sheet above the OS keyboard; on web the shim is a plain View and the browser handles input avoidance natively. autoFocus on the alarm-nickname-input inside the modal works as expected.

nickname.tsx KeyboardAwareScrollViewShim: bottomOffset={120} is forwarded to the native KeyboardAwareScrollView on iOS/Android, stripped on web (where it's a plain ScrollView). keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' is preserved on both platforms.

No file in scope exceeds 600 lines (ringtone-select.tsx 290, nickname.tsx 215, alarm-edit.tsx 597, _layout.tsx 53, KeyboardProviderShim.web.tsx 45). All interactive elements have testIDs. No HTML primitives; all text wrapped in <Text>. No raw _id leakage (frontend-only iteration).
